changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Align untouched legacy sport profiles with the skill-based initial Elo policy. Profiles with completed matches keep their earned rating.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE player_sport_profiles SET elo_rating = CASE skill_level WHEN 'BEGINNER' THEN 1000 WHEN 'INTERMEDIATE' THEN 1200 WHEN 'ADVANCED' THEN 1500 WHEN 'PRO' THEN 1800 ELSE elo_rating END WHERE COALESCE(match_count, 0) = 0 AND (elo_rating IS NULL OR elo_rating = 1000);
